title: advance
description: Move a change to the next status through its gates. Returns the new status, or GATE_REFUSED with `missing` saying what to do first.

to.description: The status to reach, for example ready or closed.

reason.description: Needed to go back or to cancel.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.
